# Load required libraries
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Set working directory (adjust as needed)
# setwd("path/to/your/data")

# ===== 1. Load the data =====
cat("Loading data...\n")

# Read the sparse matrix
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Read barcodes (cell IDs)
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(barcodes) <- "barcode"

# Read genes
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, sep = "\t")
colnames(genes) <- c("gene_id", "gene_symbol")

# Assign row and column names to the matrix
rownames(matrix) <- genes$gene_symbol
colnames(matrix) <- barcodes$barcode

cat("Data loaded successfully!\n")
cat("Dimensions:", nrow(matrix), "genes x", ncol(matrix), "cells\n\n")

# ===== 2. Calculate QC metrics =====
cat("Calculating QC metrics...\n")

# Number of genes detected per cell (genes with UMI > 0)
n_genes_per_cell <- colSums(matrix > 0)

# Total UMI counts per cell
n_umis_per_cell <- colSums(matrix)

# Identify mitochondrial genes (genes starting with "MT-" or "mt-")
mito_genes <- grep("^MT-|^mt-", rownames(matrix), value = TRUE)
cat("Found", length(mito_genes), "mitochondrial genes\n")

# Calculate percentage of mitochondrial UMIs per cell
if (length(mito_genes) > 0) {
  mito_counts <- colSums(matrix[mito_genes, , drop = FALSE])
  percent_mito <- (mito_counts / n_umis_per_cell) * 100
} else {
  percent_mito <- rep(0, ncol(matrix))
  cat("Warning: No mitochondrial genes found!\n")
}

# Create QC dataframe
qc_metrics <- data.frame(
  barcode = barcodes$barcode,
  n_genes = n_genes_per_cell,
  n_umis = n_umis_per_cell,
  percent_mito = percent_mito
)

# ===== 3. Visualize QC metrics =====
cat("\nGenerating QC plots...\n")

# Plot 1: Number of genes per cell
p1 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_genes)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 200, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2500, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Genes Detected per Cell", x = "Number of Genes", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 2: Total UMI counts per cell
p2 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umis)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "darkgreen", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Total UMI Counts per Cell", x = "UMI Counts", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 3: Percentage of mitochondrial genes
p3 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = percent_mito)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "coral", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 5, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "Mitochondrial Gene Percentage", x = "% Mitochondrial", y = "Number of Cells") +
  theme_minimal()

# Plot 4: Scatter plot - genes vs UMIs
p4 <- ggplot(qc_metrics, aes(x = n_umis, y = n_genes, color = percent_mito)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "blue", high = "red") +
  labs(title = "Genes vs UMIs", x = "Total UMI Counts", y = "Number of Genes", 
       color = "% Mito") +
  theme_minimal()

# Save plots
ggsave("qc_genes_per_cell.png", p1, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_umi_counts.png", p2, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_mito_percentage.png", p3, width = 8, height = 6)
ggsave("qc_genes_vs_umis.png", p4, width = 8, height = 6)

# Display plots
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
print(p4)

# Define filtering thresholds
min_genes <- 200      # Minimum genes detected

min_umis <- 500       # Minimum UMI counts

barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, 
                           project = "pbmc", 
                           min.cells = 3, 
                           min.features = 3, 
                           genes = genes[, 2], 
                           cells = barcodes[, 1])

# Add gene IDs to Seurat object
rownames(pbmc) <- genes[, 1]

# Filter low-quality cells
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500)
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Cluster cells
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(object = pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(object = pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Compute UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(object = pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Save Seurat object to disk
saveRDS(pbmc, file = "pbmc_final.rds")

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, rownames = genes[, 2], colnames = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)
elbow <- which.max(pbmc@reductions$pca@jackstraw$p.values[, 2])
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)

# Cluster cells
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:elbow)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Define marker genes for each cell type
marker_genes <- list(
  "CD4 T cells" = c("IL7R", "CCR7"),
  "CD14 Monocytes" = c("CD14", "LYZ"),
  "B cells" = c("MS4A1"),
  "CD8 T cells" = c("CD8A"),
  "NK cells" = c("GNLY", "NKG7")
)

# Find markers for each cluster
cluster_markers <- FindAllMarkers(pbmc, only.pos = TRUE, min.pct = 0.25, logfc.threshold = 0.25)

# Annotate clusters with cell type labels
cell_type_labels <- sapply(1:pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters, function(x) {
  cluster_marker_genes <- cluster_markers %>% filter(cluster == x) %>% pull(gene)
  cell_type <- which.max(sapply(marker_genes, function(y) sum(cluster_marker_genes %in% y)))
  names(marker_genes)[cell_type]
})

# Add cell type labels to Seurat object
pbmc@meta.data$cell_type <- cell_type_labels[pbmc@meta.data$seurat_clusters]

# Visualize UMAP with cell type labels
DimPlot(pbmc, reduction = "umap", group.by = "cell_type")

# Load necessary libraries
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(Matrix)

# Load data
barcodes <- read.table("barcodes.tsv", colClasses = "character")
genes <- read.table("genes.tsv", colClasses = c("character", "character"))
matrix <- readMM("matrix.mtx")

# Create Seurat object
pbmc <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = matrix, rownames = genes[, 1], colnames = barcodes[, 1])

# Filter cells and genes
pbmc <- subset(pbmc, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 2500 & percent.mt < 5)

# Normalize data
pbmc <- NormalizeData(pbmc, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find variable features
pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc, selection.method = "vst")

# Scale data
pbmc <- ScaleData(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Run PCA
pbmc <- RunPCA(pbmc, features = VariableFeatures(object = pbmc))

# Determine significant PCs
pbmc <- JackStraw(pbmc, num.replicate = 100)
pbmc <- ScoreJackStraw(pbmc, dims = 1:20)

# Run UMAP
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, dims = 1:10)

# Run clustering
pbmc <- FindNeighbors(pbmc, dims = 1:10)
pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc, resolution = 0.5)

# Perform differential expression analysis
cluster0 <- subset(pbmc, idents = "0")
cluster3 <- subset(pbmc, idents = "3")
diff_exp <- FindMarkers(cluster0, cluster3, only.pos = FALSE)

# Create volcano plot
volcano_data <- data.frame(
  log2FC = diff_exp$avg_logFC,
  p_val_adj = diff_exp$p_val_adj,
  significant = ifelse(abs(diff_exp$avg_logFC) > 1 & diff_exp$p_val_adj < 0.05, "yes", "no")
)

ggplot(volcano_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = significant)) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "log2 Fold Change", y = "-log10 Adjusted p-value")
